title: The Energy-Momentum-News Complex near Future Null Infinity
summary: We study asymptotically flat vacuum solutions of general relativity in three and four dimensions, with an emphasis on the geometric structures that emerge near null infinity. We construct asymptotic solutions to the three- and four-dimensional Einstein equations near future null infinity, which is a conformal Carroll manifold, starting from the most general Carroll metric data allowed by the Einstein equations.
